annotations.title: Post a message to the host

description: Post a message on a reservation's thread addressed to the Smoobu user (the host). With internal=true it is an internal note hidden from the guest — handy for logging. Cannot be unsent. Smoobu: POST /api/reservations/{reservationId}/messages/send-message-to-host.

internal.description: true = visible only to the host, hidden from the guest.

message_body.description: Message content, HTML or plain text.

name: smoobu_send_message_to_host
title: Post a message to the host
